# jQuery appear (vendored)

- Version: 0.3.6
- Source: https://github.com/morr/jquery.appear
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Usage: lazy-loads recipe cards on the browse page (`cooked-appear` handle, front end).
- Local changes: a small refactor (a helper function, semicolon style) with no change
  in behaviour. Unmaintained upstream since about 2015.

To update, replace both files and bump the version in `src/Frontend/Enqueues.php`
(`cooked-appear` handle).
